== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1785. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1466|Peter Glasgow]] and [[Dick-6841|Elizabeth Dick]]. She was baptised at Bathgate on 10 April 1785; the transcript names Peter Glasgow and Elizabeth Dick. The separately held birth claim is 4 April 1785.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691841703&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-r-691841703], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref>
